title: Per-layer dynamic scale profiles and runtime fused-op support for activation-aware INT8
creator: Ava Mitchell
description:
Goal: build a production-ready pipeline that computes per-layer dynamic activation scaling (channel-aware) profiles for INT8 rollout with optional FP8 fallback, integrates that calibration output into model packaging, and enables a fused runtime operator path that applies activation rescale + quant-dequant in a single kernel. This ticket owns engineering work for the end-to-end flow: calibration harness changes, artifact format for scale profiles, CI integration for accuracy gating, runtime fused-op kernel implementation, and rollout automation (canary + auto-fallback).

Scope of work: compute stable per-layer/channel scale statistics from representative prompt sets; generate compact profile artifacts (versioned, signed) that the runtime can fetch; extend model artifacts with calibration metadata and compatible kernel selection hints; implement fused operator in our optimized runtime (CUDA + Triton-friendly path) to eliminate redundant memory traffic and reduce latency; wire up console rollout UI flags and canary rules to exercise INT8 profiles against production traffic with safeties.

Success criteria: maintain <=1.5% relative accuracy regression on held-out eval prompts for supported models, achieve >=20% p99 latency reduction for end-to-end token generation compared to the baseline non-fused INT8 path, and ensure deterministic fallback to FP8 or fp16 when activation distribution drift exceeds thresholds.

Trade-offs & decisions: we will prioritize per-channel scaling only for attention and MLP linear layers where calibration shows strong benefit; convolution-like or attention-projection biases will keep global scaling to avoid complexity. The fused path tightens coupling between runtime kernel and profile semantics; therefore profiles must include a canonical version string and checksum to ensure kernel/profile compatibility during canary rollouts.

Observability: new calibration artifacts will publish a metrics bundle including per-layer KL divergence, max/99.9th percentiles, and a lightweight histogram for drift detection. Runtime will emit profile usage metadata and an automatic health signal when falling back.

Non-goals: training-time quant-aware calibration and model surgery are out-of-scope — this ticket focuses on post-training calibration and serving-time engineering.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration harness produces deterministic per-layer/channel scale profiles from a given prompt set and stores versioned artifacts in S3/Artifact store
Artifact schema defined and documented (version, checksum, layer map, channel scales, recommended kernel hint)
CI gating: PRs that change profile generation or artifact schema run profile replay tests and fail if relative accuracy regression >1.5% on our eval set
Runtime fused operator implemented with correctness tests (bitwise-int8 loopback equivalence within tolerance) and benchmarked on GPU targets (A10/A100)
Console rollout integration: canary flag, traffic percentage control, auto-fallback policy if drift or error rate increases
End-to-end benchmarks show >=20% p99 latency improvement vs non-fused INT8 path and unit cost reduction documented

2025-01-23 - Ravi Kapoor: Implemented prototype of per-channel collector in the calibration harness. Early runs on Llama-2-7b show 1.1% perplexity delta after applying per-layer scales vs fp16 baseline on eval suite.
2025-01-28 - Lin Chen (MLR): Reviewed artifact schema; requested explicit checksum+kernel_hint fields and signed metadata so runtime can safely cache profiles. Added to attachments.

2025-01-30 - QA: Calibration replay job added to CI (see PR). Observed non-determinism when collecting on multi-process sampling. Action: add deterministic seed and single-pass aggregator. Assigned to Priya.

2025-02-02 - Ravi Kapoor: Fused CUDA kernel drafted. Microbenchmarks show ~28% p99 improvement on A10 for short sequences. Need to add correctness tests against non-fused reference implementation and address corner-case overflow handling.

2025-02-04 - Security: Asked for threat model for artifact fetching signed metadata to avoid malicious profile injections. Proposed short-lived signed URLs + runtime signature verification. Follow-up: schedule security review in next sprint.
2025-02-05 - Ava Mitchell: Updated acceptance criteria to include CI gating and canary rollback policy. Set due date to 2025-03-01.
notes: Calibration datasets: use production-sampled prompt buckets (privacy-filtered) + synthetic prompt augmentation to cover tail distributions
Fallback strategy: runtime compares live activation histograms to profile percentiles; if 99.9th exceedance > threshold, instantly switch to FP8/FP16 path for that model instance and emit telemetry
Profile format: JSONL for human inspection, gzipped protobuf for runtime consumption; both must be supported by packaging tooling
Kernel compatibility: kernels must advertise supported profile schema version; runtime performs semantic check before enabling fused path
